name: claude-novelai-scripts
description: NovelAI user scripts: Text Adventure+ and Story Adventure+.

naiscripts.name: Text Adventure+
naiscripts.author: Infamase
naiscripts.description: Stops Text Adventure output when it is your turn, and adds Party and Inventory tabs that feed the story context.

naiscripts.name: Story Adventure+
naiscripts.author: Infamase
naiscripts.description: Keeps Story mode in second person, present tense with a writing guide against AI cliches, and adds Player, Party and Inventory tabs that feed the story context.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
